doc_title_en: Notification Regarding Results of Public Tender Offer for Yamadai Corporation (Code 7426) and Changes to Subsidiaries
doc_title_jp: 株式会社山大（証券コード：7426）に対する公開買付けの結果及び子会社の異動に関するお知らせ

key_facts.method: public tender offer + concurrent acquisition from founders

summary_en: Public tender offer for Yamadai (TSE Standard, code 7426) completed 6 Jun–3 Aug 2026. Tendered: 365,834 shares (33.0% of ex-treasury S/O) at ¥601/share. Concurrent acquisition from two founding-family shareholders: 338,000 shares without tender. Settlement: 10 Aug 2026. Yamadai becomes Nice's wholly owned subsidiary upon completion.
summary_jp: 山大の公開買付（6月2日～8月3日）完了。応募365,834株（S/O 33.0%）、¥601/株。並行買付：創業家2社から338,000株を無償取得。決済：2026年8月10日。完全子会社化。
tag_en: M&A - Nice acquires Yamadai (7426) via tender offer - 365,834 shares (33.0% S/O) tendered + 338,000 founder shares - ¥601/share - Makes Yamadai wholly owned subsidiary
tag_jp: M&A - ナイスが山大を公開買付で買収 - 365,834株（S/O 33.0%）応募 + 創業家338,000株 - ¥601/株 - 完全子会社化

doc_title_en: Notice regarding change in tender offer terms for Yamada Corporation (TSE Code: 7426)
doc_title_jp: 株式会社山大（証券コード：7426）に対する公開買付けの買付条件等の変更に関するお知らせ
summary_en: Tender offer minimum acceptance threshold lowered from 402,600 to 261,700 shares (23.56% of outstanding ex-treasury). Tender price ¥601/share unchanged. Offer period extended to 44 business days, closing 3 August 2026. Target board recommends acceptance. Goal: complete subsidiary acquisition.
summary_jp: 公開買付下限を402,600株から261,700株に引下（発行済株式総数比23.56%）。買付価格 ¥601/株は据置。営業日44日（2026年8月3日迄）に延長。対象者が応募推奨。完全子会社化目的。
tag_en: MBO – Yamada Corporation – tender price ¥601/share – minimum acceptance lowered from 402,600 to 261,700 shares – period extended to 44 business days (through 3 Aug 2026) – complete subsidiary
tag_jp: MBO – 山大 – 公開買付価格 ¥601/株 – 下限引下 402,600株→261,700株 – 営業日44日延長（2026年8月3日迄） – 完全子会社化

summary_en: Tender offer for Yamadai Corp. (7426) by Nice Corp. (8089) extended from 40 to 40 business days (13 Jul to 28 Jul 2026). Offer price ¥601/share. Minimum acceptance 402,600 shares. Purpose: full subsidiary. Board of Yamadai recommends acceptance. No change to price, minimum threshold, or terms; extension provides shareholders additional time to respond.
summary_jp: 山大に対する公開買付期間を7月28日迄に延長（40営業日）。買付価格601円/株、下限402,600株。完全子会社化目的。山大取締役会推奨。価格・下限等の条件変更なし。

doc_title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for Yamadai Corporation (Securities Code: 7426)
doc_title_jp: 株式会社山大（証券コード：7426）に対する公開買付けの開始に関するお知らせ
summary_en: Yamadai (7426) public tender offer at ¥601/share (minimum 402,600 shares, 36.24% S/O) to achieve complete subsidiary status. Founder shareholders (30.43% stake) committed to parallel sale at ¥301/share. Target board recommends. Period: 2 June–13 July 2026 (30 business days).
summary_jp: 山大(7426)公開買付：¥601/株、最低402,600株(36.24% S/O)で完全子会社化。創業家株主(30.43%)は¥301/株で並行買付。取締役会賛同。期間：2026年6月2日～7月13日(営業日30日)。
